claim: Students who use the tutoring assistant retain at least 15% more course material after six months than students who use the existing study guide.
summary: No six-month outcome exists; the two-week result cannot decide the long-term claim.

claim: The complete launch scope can be delivered by the two-person team within ten weeks without any capacity lever.
summary: Required work is 1,120 hours before contingency and 1,344 after reserve versus 800 hours of fixed capacity.

claim: The approved matrix selects the custom SSR application.
summary: Static plus CMS scores 4.8; SSR scores 3.3 and fails the operational-burden gate.

claim: Variant B causally improves conversion and should roll out universally based on the aggregate rate.
summary: The aggregate lift follows imbalanced device allocation; desktop directly contradicts a universal rollout.

claim: Removing names and emails makes the restricted customer-support payload safe to send externally.
summary: Pseudonymization does not change the supplied restricted-data policy or create the missing approval and processor contract.

claim: CursorAdapter reports provider cursor without model-prefix inference and rejects model auto before process creation.
summary: The literal capability, first-statement model guard, and must-not-run contract test support the bounded invariant.

claim: The npm dry-run receipt reports required runtime/example paths present and no match against its listed forbidden rules.
summary: The six required fields are true and forbiddenMatches is empty; the receipt does not independently prove a future tarball or registry artifact.
